title: While loops
syllabusDesc: Repeat while a condition stays true; update the condition to avoid infinite loops.
desc: Repeat while a condition stays true; remember to update the condition inside the loop.

challenges.title: Countdown
challenges.prompt: Print 5 down to 1 using a while loop, then print "Blastoff!".
challenges.solution:
n = 5
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n -= 1
print("Blastoff!")

challenges.title: Guessing game
challenges.prompt: Keep asking for a number until the user types 7, then print "Correct".
challenges.solution:
secret = 7
guess = None
while guess != secret:
    guess = int(input("Guess: "))
print("Correct")

challenges.title: Sum until zero
challenges.prompt: Read integers until the user enters 0; then print the total sum.
challenges.solution:
total = 0
num = None
while num != 0:
    num = int(input("Number (0 to stop): "))
    total += num
print(total)

challenges.title: Find first even
challenges.prompt: Given nums, walk through with a while loop and print the first even number, then stop.
challenges.solution:
nums = [3, 9, 11, 4, 8]
i = 0
while i < len(nums):
    if nums[i] % 2 == 0:
        print(nums[i])
        break
    i += 1
